summary: Fresh Thursday-morning sportsbook repricing materially improves the threshold on Jahmyr Gibbs receiving yards at BetRivers while worsening juice: Covers odds last updated 08:25 ET show BetRivers O28.5 -119, DraftKings O29.5 -115, FanDuel O30.5 -113, Fanatics O30.5 -115, Caesars O30.5 -114, BetMGM O32.5 -115, Hard Rock O30.5 -115 and theScore O29.5 -130. PRIME recalculates O28.5 -119 at a conservative 59% fair Over probability, yielding about +4.66 percentage points versus the raw -119 break-even rate; classify BET_NOW at 0.5u, preferred to the higher 29.5 threshold. DraftKings O29.5 -115 remains STILL_PLAYABLE at the stored 58% fair probability, but it is exactly at the prior ceiling. Do not duplicate the same-thesis exposure and do not chase 30.5+. Projection disagreement remains material: numberFire projects 39.88 receiving yards, Dimers 33.1, DraftEdge 38.6, while FIC projects 28.1; Covers/Kalshi prices 30+ at 49%. The role thesis remains supported by Gibbs' 74.7% Week 1 snap share, five targets/five catches for 30 yards and removal of David Montgomery from the backfield. Detroit's final injury report still has starting OL Christian Mahogany and Blake Miller OUT; Buffalo lists Ty Johnson, Cole Bishop and T.J. Sanders questionable. Kincaid remains WATCH, not BET. Judkins' last verified rushing-attempt quote remains stale at bet365 O12.5 -105 from 19:37 ET Wednesday. No new Grok pass.
